 Jackson and Joao Pedro break all-time transfer RECORDS in FPL
 01 Nov 2026
 Villa forward becomes most-bought player ever in a Gameweek, while Chelsea star is most-sold
 Nicolas Jackson (£7.0m) became the most-bought player in a Gameweek EVER, with more than 2.3million Fantasy Premier League managers transferring in the Aston Villa forward for Gameweek 9. 
 He surpasses the record set by Cristiano Ronaldo in Gameweek 4 of the 2021/22 season, when the Portuguese star rejoined Manchester United. On that occasion, Ronaldo scored two goals at home to Newcastle United to reward his 2.2m new owners with a 13-point haul.
 Jackson came close to emulating that performance as Unai Emery's side drew 1-1 with Fulham at Villa Park, after scoring and claiming the maximum three bonus for a nine-point return.
 The Senegal international is currently the most in-form player in Fantasy, having totalled 39 points since Gameweek 5.

Marcus Tavernier (£6.6m) gained 1.5m new owners for Gameweek 9 as AFC Bournemouth embark on a kind run of matches. Over the next 10 Gameweeks, they play just one side rated above three in the Fixture Difficulty Ratings (FDR), where the easiest possible match is rated as one and the hardest possible is rated as five.
 That run began with a home encounter against Leeds United on Saturday, which the Cherries won 2-0 thanks to goals from  Evanilson (£6.4m) and Amine Adli (£4.8m), but Tavernier blanked for the first time in three appearances.
 Goalscorer Evanilson was the third player recruited by over a million Fantasy bosses in Gameweek 9. His goal was his fourth in as many matches, earning his new owners nine points as he claimed the maximum three bonus. 
 Joao Pedro becomes most-sold player
 With Jackson becoming the most-bought player of all time,  Joao Pedro (£7.7m) became the most-sold.
 The Brazilian was ruled out of Chelsea's 2-0 win over Manchester United on Saturday by manager Xabi Alonso and is set for a spell on the sidelines. More than 3.3m FPL managers promptly parted company with him.
 His total sellers surpass the previous high of 3.2m recorded by Cole Palmer (£9.8m) in Gameweek 3 last season.
